Strange. Does neovim crash when you open it, or at random times?
Try to run it on the normal OSX terminal. What happens?
Try to run it in bash instead of zsh. What happens?

Current master is rather unstable right now, we're working through some segfaults. Please roll back to https://github.com/neovim/neovim/commit/75c18b6aaa8430596fa10466dc7918047b13ff2b or the 0.1.7 release in the meantime.

@vatrat crashes at random times, in this commit tests started failing https://github.com/neovim/neovim/commit/5e4eb18eb0242794c0b3a622f7acf0d3e6856c05 I don't know if at this point starts the segfaults.

I just see new commit (https://github.com/neovim/neovim/commit/02a9824438adb89eed8b0230068bb95bbf7ce97c) I will test it.
I can confirm that yesterday it was crashing on Ubuntu 16.10 using Bash. Will try today again.

issue.title: Received unexpected redraw arguments, expecting list QVariant(QByteArray, "redraw")

repository.name: neovim-qt
repository.description: Neovim client library and GUI, in Qt5.

issue.body:
Since updating the latest neovim (NVIM v0.2.0-144-g02a9824), I am getting this error at random times:

```
Received unexpected redraw arguments, expecting list QVariant(QByteArray, "redraw")
Received unexpected redraw arguments, expecting list QVariant(QByteArray, "redraw")
```

It seems to happen when there is an error in neovim -- in the latest case, a `vim-airline` one.

Do you need more information?

Any idea what could be causing this?

body:
random crashes in Ubuntu 16.04 LTS with neovim installed for Neovim PPA (https://launchpad.net/~neovim-ppa/+archive/ubuntu/unstable) we can't install a rollback or 1.7 release from the PPA, this always give to Ubuntu master branch release.

If you can see a related things months ago in #1579 i suggested a change in the PPA that can help Ubuntu users now and in the future with this bug and something similar

with my dotfiles i can 100% reproduced the crash。

```
$ mkdir test
$ mkdir test2
$ nvim test/index.js
:w<CR>
,e " my key map to open the NERDTree
md " nerdtree key map to delete the test directory
:yes<CR> " type yes to delete the test directory
o " nerdtree key map to open the test2 directory
now neovim crash
```
